objective: Require explicit user review of the decomposed work plan, dependency graph, AR manifest, and concise design document before implementation ARs proceed.
assumptions: Coordinator owns task lifecycle and revisions
AWG stores bounded public references rather than private transcripts
unknowns: Projects may choose their own planning-document formats
invariants: All four planning artifacts have versioned before and after references
Review is bound to the exact Coordinator task revision
Implementation readiness requires an explicit approve or reject disposition
A missing or stale artifact or absent review fails closed
User approval does not prove implementation correctness
acceptance_predicates: Missing review, missing artifact, stale revision, and implicit approval reject
